rules.name: rrr-mtm-order-probe-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT row_number() OVER () AS fn_order, p.trade_id, p.contract_number, p.client_code, p.product_code, p.derivative_type, p.opt_periodicity, p.is_premium_paid, p.active_lots::text AS active_lots, p.mult_factor::text AS mult_factor, p.original_premium::text AS original_premium, p.nc_factor::text AS nc_factor, p.fx_nc_factor::text AS fx_nc_factor, p.mtm_usd::text AS mtm_usd, p.mtm_nc::text AS mtm_nc, p.mkt_value_usd::text AS mkt_value_usd, p.mkt_value_nc::text AS mkt_value_nc, p.fixing_date FROM opera.fn_client_statement_position_rows_v2( (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), CAST(:bu AS text), CAST(:valueDate AS date), CAST('["JUP","VCI"]' AS jsonb)) p

SELECT c.uuid::text AS uuid, c.trade_id, c.contract_number, c.client_code, c.derivative_type, c.is_premium_paid, c.active_lots::text AS active_lots, c.premium_paid_usd::text AS premium_paid_usd, c.premium_paid_nc::text AS premium_paid_nc, c.mtm_usd::text AS mtm_usd, c.mkt_value_usd::text AS mkt_value_usd, c.created_timestamp, c.created_by FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND c.contract_number IS NOT NULL AND upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('JUP', 'VCI') ORDER BY c.created_timestamp, c.uuid

SELECT d.contract_number, d.mtm_post_dripping_today_usd::text AS mtm_post_dripping_today_usd, d.mtm_post_dripping_today::text AS mtm_post_dripping_today FROM opera.client_dripping_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND d.business_unit = :bu AND d.value_date = :valueDate AND upper(split_part(d.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('JUP', 'VCI')

SELECT r.cob_date, r.client_code, r.mtm::text AS mtm, r.ftd_pnl::text AS ftd_pnl, r.updated_timestamp FROM opera.rrr_report_table r WHERE r.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND r.business_unit = :bu AND r.cob_date IN (DATE '2026-09-30', DATE '2026-10-01') AND upper(trim(r.client_code)) IN ('JUP', 'VCI') ORDER BY 2, 1
